alate: 有翅成虫头部暗褐，上唇、后唇基、额前角与口器锈黄，触角褐色。头部密被毛，前胸背板之毛亦密。头作宽卵形，后唇基的长度不及宽度之半；单眼与复眼之间的距离短于单眼宽度之半；囟卵形，相当大。触角十五节，第二、四节长度约略相等，均长于第三节。前胸背板褐黄，具黄色 T 形斑与肩斑，后缘略凹。前翅中脉有一至三个分支。
en: Only the alate is described. Its head is dark brown, the labrum, postclypeus, frontal corners and mouthparts rusty yellow, and the antennae brown; head and pronotum are densely hairy. The head is broadly oval, the postclypeus less than half as long as wide, the ocellus-to-eye distance less than half the ocellar width, and the fontanelle large and oval. Antennae have 15 segments, the second and fourth about equal and longer than the third.
